IceHRM Pro API (2.0.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

IceHRM Support: support@icehrm.com URL: https://icehrm.com License: MIT

IceHRM is an open-source Human Resource Management system. This API provides programmatic access to manage employees, attendance, leave, payroll, projects, and other HR-related functions.

Authentication

All endpoints require Bearer token authentication unless otherwise noted. Use the OAuth token endpoint to obtain an access token.

Response Format

Successful responses return data wrapped in an IceResponse object. Error responses use the format: {"error": [[{"code": 400, "message": "..."}]]}

Responses

{protocol}://{host}/api/v1/employees/custom-fields

  • 200
  • 403
Content type
application/json
[

    • "id": 12,
    • "type": "Employee",
    • "name": "sg_residency",
    • "field_type": "select",
    • "field_label": "Residency Status",
    • "field_validation": null,
    • "field_options": "[{\"value\":\"SC\",\"label\":\"Singapore Citizen\"},{\"value\":\"PR\",\"label\":\"PR\"}]",
    • "display": "Form",
    • "display_section": "Payroll",
    • "display_order": 0
    }
]

Create Employee Custom Field Definition

Creates a new employee custom field. The field name must be unique for the Employee type, at most 20 characters, and not a reserved column name. Admin only.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required
name
required
string <= 20 characters
field_type
required
string
Enum: "text" "textarea" "select" "select2" "select2multi" "date" "datetime" "time" "fileupload"
field_label
required
string
field_validation
string or null
string or Array of objects

Options for select-type fields. Accepts a JSON string or an array of {value, label} objects (arrays are JSON-encoded server-side).

display
string
Default: "Form"
Enum: "Form" "Table and Form" "Hidden"
display_section
string or null
display_order
integer
Default: 0

Responses

IceHRM API Server

{protocol}://{host}/api/v1/employees/custom-fields

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{
  • "name": "sg_residency",
  • "field_type": "select",
  • "field_label": "Residency Status",
  • "field_validation": "string",
  • "field_options": [
    • {
      • "value": "SC",
      • "label": "Singapore Citizen"
      },
    • {
      • "value": "PR",
      • "label": "PR"
      }
    ],
  • "display": "Form",

}

Create a Task List

Create a task list from a list of tasks. type defaults to "General" when empty. Tasks may be assigned to employees inline (task object with an employee id) and/or via the separate assignments array; tasks with no employee stay unassigned. owner defaults to the employee that owns the access token when omitted. Each assigned employee is notified.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required
name
required
string
description
string

Optional description shown under the title.

type
string
Default: "General"

Task list type. Defaults to "General" when empty.

owner
integer

Owner employee id. Defaults to the employee that owns the access token when omitted.

status
string
Default: "Open"
Enum: "Draft" "Open" "On-hold" "Completed"
required
Array of strings or objects (TaskListTaskInput) non-empty
Array of objects (TaskAssignmentInput)

Optional per-task assignments applied by index.

Add Expense with Optional Receipt Upload

Create a new expense request with optional receipt image upload.

Receipt Upload for Mobile Apps (Flutter, React Native, etc.): You can include receipt images captured via camera directly in the JSON payload using base64 encoding. This eliminates the need for a separate file upload step.

Supported formats: jpg, jpeg, png, gif, bmp, webp, heic, heif Maximum file size: 10MB per image Maximum attachments: 3 receipts per expense

Base64 Format Options:

  • With data URI: "data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQ..."
  • Raw base64: "/9j/4AAQSkZJRg..."

Alternative: Separate File Upload: You can also upload files separately using /expenses/file-upload and reference the returned filename in attachment1, attachment2, or attachment3.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required
expense_date
string <date>

Date of the expense

payment_method
required
integer

Payment method ID (from /expense/payment-methods)

transaction_no
string

Transaction reference number

payee
required
string

Vendor/payee name

category
required
integer

Expense category ID (from /expense/categories)

notes
string

Additional notes about the expense

currency
integer

Currency ID

amount
number <decimal>

Expense amount

receipt
string

Base64-encoded receipt image (primary attachment). Accepts data URI format (data:image/jpeg;base64,...) or raw base64 string. Ideal for camera-captured images from mobile apps (Flutter, React Native).

receipt_filename
string

Optional original filename for the receipt

receipt2
string

Base64-encoded second receipt image (optional)

receipt2_filename
string

Optional filename for second receipt

receipt3
string

Base64-encoded third receipt image (optional)

receipt3_filename
string

Optional filename for third receipt

Responses

IceHRM API Server

{protocol}://{host}/api/v1/expense

Upload Expense Attachment (Multipart)

Upload an expense attachment using multipart form data. This is an alternative to base64 encoding in the expense submission.

After uploading, use the returned filename in attachment1, attachment2, or attachment3 fields when creating an expense.

Note: For mobile apps, consider using the base64 receipt field in POST /expense instead for a simpler single-request workflow.

Clear Payroll Data (Destructive)

Permanently deletes the selected categories of payroll data. Each category is opt-in via targets. Requires the exact confirmation phrase DELETE PAYROLL DATA (also enforced by the UI). Export a backup first if the data may be needed again.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required
targets
required
Array of strings
Items Enum: "columns" "payrolls" "designs" "groups"

One or more of the categories to delete.

confirm
required
string

Must equal "DELETE PAYROLL DATA".

Responses

IceHRM API Server

{protocol}://{host}/api/v1/payroll_config/clear

  • 400
